content.short: Fazz is a Southeast Asian business finance platform with accounts, payment acceptance and financing.
content.description: Fazz is a Southeast Asian financial platform serving businesses from micro-merchants to larger companies across Singapore and Indonesia. Its Fazz Business account brings together multi-currency accounts, payment acceptance, disbursements and working-capital financing, so companies can collect, hold and move money and access credit in one place. The wider Fazz group also runs StraitsX, the regulated issuer of the Singapore-dollar and US-dollar stablecoins XSGD and XUSD, giving it a foothold in stablecoin payments infrastructure. For everyday business customers, Fazz focuses on the accounts, payments and financing that help regional SMEs and merchants run and grow.
content.meta: Fazz offers business accounts, payments and financing across Southeast Asia. Discover Fazz and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
